access.heading: What you need
access.compatibility: Claude and ChatGPT logos indicate compatibility, not endorsement.

items.a: Telemetrio MCP connects Claude or ChatGPT to available Telemetrio data so you can search Telegram channels through conversation.
Channels matching your geography and category. You can combine criteria and refine them as the conversation continues.

items.q: Can I find every Telegram channel?
items.a: Search results depend on the channels available in Telemetrio’s database. Some channels may be missing or have incomplete data.

items.q: What does a channel’s geography mean?
items.a: It refers to the channel’s geographic classification in Telemetrio. It does not mean that every subscriber is located in that country.
items.verify: Adjust to the verified geographic data definition.
